newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles Myer shares hold firm on results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles Myer shares hold firm on results.

text.p: Shares in Australian retailer Coles Myer Ltd held their ground despite a weaker overall market on Thursday, after reporting a surge in half-year earnings.
The stock was trading at A$5.92 at 2320 GMT (10.20 a.m.), up one cent on Wednesday's close, though the All Ordinaries leading indicator was down nine points at 2445.4 at the opening.
"The share price is actually holding very well," a Sydney broker told Reuters.

"I think the result itself is pretty much in line (with expectations) but what is important are people's expectations of the turnaround now. I think that's why the stock is where it is, on anticipation of much better margins and profit."

Earlier on Thursday, Coles Myer reported a 40.7 percent leap in net profit after abnormals to A$273.6 million for the 26 weeks ended January 26. Before abnormals, net profit rose 23.1 percent to A$229 million against the same period a year ago.
Australia's biggest retailer also forecast more double-digit profit growth in the second half of the year ending July 27.
